dogecoin.text: You called out someone for being "spineless" and a "fence sitter" for simply working on a commission. While yes the commission was from a not-so-great person (the creator of Dogecoin), it doesn't warrant any harassment against the artist.

@missjackieart I checked them out, the only "controversial" thing they did was make a VTuber model for the creator behind Dogecoin, which they were commissioned to do.
Unless there were some other posts they deleted, I don't really see what the problem is?
